items.briefing:
Australian and New Zealand organisations are being warned of a significant rise in critical software vulnerabilities, with cybersecurity researchers reporting a surge in serious flaws being actively exploited in the region. This aligns with a global campaign targeting a high-severity flaw in VMware vCenter, which is widely used in Australian business environments. Separately, AI-driven cybercrime is growing rapidly in scale and sophistication, while ransomware groups are hitting record numbers despite victim counts stabilising.

July also saw a broader global spike in cyberattacks and ransomware incidents. If your organisation runs VMware vCenter, confirm with your IT team that recent security patches have been applied immediately.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Patch backlogs leaving Australian organisations exposed to 85 critical security flaws.
